title: Bounded integer
description: Shared integer ranges for counters, versions, priorities, and durations. Every non-monetary integer property in the contract references one of the $defs below so all implementations share one interoperable range; monetary amounts use money.schema.json instead.

nonNegativeInteger.description: Zero or greater. The upper bound is 2^53 - 1 so every conforming value is exact in JSON, IEEE 754 doubles, and 64-bit integers.
